glossary.definition: (1) "Pre-college stackable certificate" means a certificate earned before an adult is enrolled in an institution of higher education that can be transferred to college credit based on standards established by the chancellor of higher education and the department of education and workforce.
glossary.source_title: Section 3333.34 - College-level certificates transferable to college credit.
